validation.notes: Fault located in packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts, migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot(): the session directory encoder used cwd.replace(/^[/\\]/, "").replace(/[/:]/g, "-") so backslashes were never replaced; drive-letter cwds such as C:\Users\me\proj became '--C-\Users\me\proj--' and UNC cwds \\server\share\proj became '--\server\share\proj--', migrating sessions into a wrong directory (session-manager.ts getDefaultSessionDirPath already used the correct /[/\\:]/g form). Fix is a one-character-class change to cwd.replace(/^[/\\]/, "").replace(/[/\\:]/g, "-") plus nothing else; no other production file was touched (git diff: 1 file, 1 line). .prale-eval/regression.mjs loads the real module through .prale-eval/subject.mjs loadMigrations(root, agentDir) with real fs/path and a temporary agentDir under .prale-eval/.tmp (removed in a finally block), then asserts: POSIX (/home/user/proj -> --home-user-proj--), drive-letter (C:\Users\me\proj -> --C--Users-me-proj--), UNC (\\server\share\proj -> ---server-share-proj--), colon (/srv/repo:name -> --srv-repo-name--) and CRLF-header (D:\work\app -> --D--work-app--) cwds land in the exact expected session directories; session bytes are preserved byte-for-byte including a non-UTF-8 payload (move, not rewrite); invalid headers (non-JSON, missing cwd, non-session type) are ignored and left byte-identical at the agent root; a pre-existing destination file is never overwritten and its source is kept; and two extra runs are idempotent (no duplicate directories, unchanged bytes). Verified the regression is fault-sensitive: with the original /[/:]/g code re-inserted temporarily it fails with AssertionError (exit 1) on the session-directory set, and with the fix it exits 0. Limitation: vitest and typescript are not installed in this workspace (no node_modules) and dependencies were not installed per instructions, so no vitest/tsc run was possible; validation relies on Node 24 built-ins only (stripTypeScriptTypes + vm modules).
